title: Oven-Roasted Miso-Glazed Northern-Irish Christmas Pudding Pastie
description: A vegetarian-friendly twist on the traditional Cornish pasty, featuring a miso-marinated filling with Christmas pudding, served in a clay pot.
instructions: Cut the Christmas pudding into small cubes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the miso paste, maple syrup, melted coconut oil, and 2 tablespoons of water to make the glaze.
In a separate bowl, mix the flour, salt, and black pepper.
Using a pastry brush, apply a thin layer of the glaze to the inside of a 6-inch clay pot or ramekin.
Add a few cubes of the Christmas pudding to the clay pot, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle a pinch of the flour mixture over the pudding.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of flour mixture on top.
Cover the clay pot with a piece of parchment paper and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the parchment paper and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Let the pastie cool for 5 minutes before serving.
